results.title: The Java runtime | App Engine flexible environment | Google Cloud Documentation
results.description: If you are using an extended image you can activate quickstart by executing /scripts/jetty/quickstart.sh in your Dockerfile, after the application WAR is added. You can set the following optional environment variables that are specific to the Java 8/Jetty 9 runtime. You can set OpenJDK 8 environment variables as well. To set environment variables, use the env_variables key in the app.yaml file. When running on the App Engine flexible environment, you can configure Java Util Logging to send logs to Cloud Logging by setting the JETTY_ARGS environment variable.
